title: Scenic Trails of Thailand | Journey through Phuket, Koh Samui & Krabi with Full-Moon Party
highlights: Journey across Phuket, Koh Phangan, Koh Samui, and Krabi with island hopping, iconic parties, scenic beaches, tropical adventures and the iconic full-moon party.
Explore Phi Phi’s icons—Maya Bay, Pileh Lagoon, Viking Cave, and Monkey Beach—paired with snorkeling and crystal-clear Andaman waters.
Experience the legendary Full Moon Party with neon lights, fire shows, global DJs, and an electrifying beach-party vibe till sunrise.
Marvel at the Phranang Cave at Railay Beach, where dramatic limestone cliffs and sacred lingam carvings blend myth, culture, and coastal beauty.
Witness the Viking Cave on Phi Phi Island, famous for its ancient wall paintings and swiftlet nests set within towering limestone cliffs.
overview:
About the Tour:
This Thailand island-hopping getaway blends tropical beauty, nightlife, and adventure into one unforgettable journey across Phuket, Koh Phangan, Koh Samui, and Krabi. Begin in Phuket, where vibrant streets, historic old-town charm, and beach sunsets set the tone. Cruise through the Andaman Sea on a Phi Phi Islands speedboat tour, exploring Maya Bay, Pileh Lagoon, Viking Cave, and snorkelling-rich islands. Fly to Koh Samui and sail to Koh Phangan for the legendary Full Moon Party, where neon lights, fire shows, and global beats light up the night. Slow things down with beach days, cafés, and island strolls before heading to Krabi. Explore lively night markets and set out on the classic 4 Islands Tour, covering Railay Beach, Phranang Cave, Chicken Island, Tup Island, and Poda Island. A perfect mix of party energy, island exploration, and scenic escapes, this tour offers the best of Thailand’s coastal magic.

know_before_you_go: Room sharing may be with either male or female guests, with accommodations provided on a twin-sharing basis only.
A tour guide will be available only if the group consists of 10 or more travelers.
Airport pickups are scheduled for 2 PM.
Travelers arriving outside the scheduled pickup time must arrange their own transport to the hotel. We recommend booking flights according to the suggested timings.
On the final day, departures will be scheduled between 9-10 AM after breakfast.
Thailand’s cuisine is predominantly non-vegetarian, and strictly vegetarian or Jain meal options cannot be guaranteed.
It is recommended to carry 10,000 THB in cash, as forex cards may not be accepted at all locations.
We are not liable for compensation if any activities are missed by travelers.
Surcharges and mandatory festival dinners may apply for hotel stays during Christmas and New Year.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Phuket | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to the tropical island of Phuket! Upon arrival at the airport, board your transfer and get driven to your hotel. After check-in, spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can relax or explore the city on your own. You may explore Bangla Street, famous for its buzzing nightlife and neon glow, or wander through Phuket Old Town with its colorful Sino-Portuguese streets and cafés, or relax by the shores of Patong Beach, soaking in the island’s vibrant evening atmosphere.

days.title: Day Trip to Phi Phi Islands
days.desc: Set out for an unforgettable Phi Phi Islands adventure today. Board your transfer from the hotel to Phuket Marina and hop onto a long-tail to explore Thailand’s most iconic islands. Visit the breathtaking Maya Bay and swim in the emerald waters of Pileh Lagoon. Also, marvel at the ancient wall paintings at Viking Cave and spot playful monkeys at Monkey Beach. Continue to he famous Phi Phi Don, Bamboo Island, and Khai Nok Island for snorkeling and beach time before getting driven to your hotel.

days.title: Fly to Koh Samui | Transfer to Koh Phangan for Full Moon Party
days.desc: Check out and get transferred to the airport for your flight to Koh Samui. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and recharge. In the evening, get driven to the Koh Samui Pier and board a speedboat to Haad Rin Beach, Koh Phangan, the legendary home of the Full Moon Party. Once there, watch the beach transform with neon lights, fire shows, and DJ beats from around the world. Dance under the glowing full moon, sip tropical drinks, and celebrate till sunrise in this iconic party experience.

days.title: Transfer to Koh Samui | Day at Leisure
days.desc: After an epic night, ease into a relaxed day. Board the morning ferry back to Koh Samui and relax at your hotel. Later, explore the island at your own pace—walk along Chaweng Beach, enjoy a fire dance show, or grab a meal with your group at Fisherman’s Village. You can also visit popular cafés like Jungle Club for stunning sunset views. Spend the day soaking in laid-back island vibes before your next adventure.

days.title: Transfer to Krabi | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Check out from your hotel and get driven to the Koh Samui Pier for your ferry to Krabi. Upon arrival in Krabi, get driven to your hotel and check in. Spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can head out and explore Krabi Weekend Night Market filled with vibrant stalls filled with sizzling Thai street food, local snacks, handicrafts, and souvenirs. This market is the heart of Krabi’s evening culture, offering an authentic taste of local flavours, nightlife, and colourful street vibes.

days.title: Krabi 4 Islands Tour by Speedboat
days.desc: Get ready for a Krabi island-hopping adventure. Board your transfer to Klong Jilad Pier and set off by speedboat for the famous 4 Islands Tour. Visit the stunning Railay Beach and explore Phranang Cave, known for its sacred lingam carvings set against dramatic limestone cliffs. Continue to Chicken Island, famous for its unique chicken-shaped rock formation, followed by Tup Island and Poda Island, where crystal-clear waters invite snorkeling and relaxation. Afterwards, get driven to the hotel.
